name: io.github.anusornc/kala-mcp
title: kala-mcp
description: The kala memory layer as an MCP server: six tools over stdio — context, record, recall, read, history, turns — over a single-writer, provenance-by-construction memory store with Datalog recall and as-of time travel.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.distribution: Clojars (io.github.anusornc/kala-mcp) or a standalone executable jar built with `clojure -T:build mcp-uberjar`
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.listingBlocker: The official registry's package registryTypes (npm, pypi, cargo, oci, nuget, mcpb) include no Maven/Clojars type as of the 2025-12-11 schema; a listing needs an OCI-shimmed jar or upstream support.
